architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0042 for the parity gate: what it checks, exit-code contract, fail-closed, and the deferred provenance/uniqueness
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the new gate ships a discrimination test for every exit path
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added check-skill-gate-parity.mjs and a test that builds fixture repos with real and tampered hashes, asserting 0 in-parity, 1 for each drift/missing/unsanctioned/traversal class, 2 fail-closed
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven contract test is the right level for a file-scanning gate; no integration/e2e surface
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; behavior is committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the gate's behavior is specified in the merged bootstrap-v2 feature files (sync-drift, malicious-actor); this change implements the parity gate they assume, with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the gate reads file paths from a potentially attacker-controlled manifest
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: added a path-containment guard so a manifest cannot point a gate script outside the repo (path traversal via ../); the gate refuses to hash an arbitrary file and flags it, with a test case
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR is explicit about what is and is not yet enforced
skeptical-audit.what: stated that the aggregator and provenance gate are deferred and that id/script uniqueness is not yet enforced here
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch review over the parity gate, its test, and the ADR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI gate script; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a straightforward file-scanning check

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

arch-encode.why: the gate is planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
